_about: Fine-tuning stages run by RunTrain.ps1. Keys starting with _ are comments.
_device: What this machine can carry: 8 GB of VRAM and a WSL2 VM with 28 GB, see the Readme. batch and workers are the values the runs converged with.
_train: Passed to yolo detect train for every stage. A stage's args and -Set on the command line override these.
_stages: model is read from paths.models, data names a yaml in paths.datasets. stop_after ends the run after that many epochs while epochs stays at 100, so the learning-rate schedule is the one of a 100 epoch run. export is where best.pt is copied when the stage ends.

nvg_clean._note: hand-tuned chain, stage 1; ran on 8.3.221 against a single coco_nvg folder
nvg_clean.name: finetune_yolo11s_nvg_clean
